title: Starter template: default site settings, brand pack, pages and clearly labelled sample content
description:
Outcome: A new tenant opens a working, presentable site: the publication preset with a neutral brand pack that passes the validator, three sections, a home page from the default home template, an about page, and two sample stories labelled as samples (the deploy-incrementally-with-placeholders rule) that the onboarding offers to delete. The template is versioned data in core, not code per tenant.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new src/papyrus_content/starter/ (SiteConfig, BrandPack, pages, sample stories as Markus), the brand pack validator (PPY-88a883), home templates (PPY-b21340).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/starter-site.feature):
Scenario: A new site passes every platform policy check
    Given a tenant created from the starter template
    When its site is projected and checked
    Then the brand pack passes the validator and the browser policy checks pass in light and dark

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-cf7e6e, PPY-1252ce, PPY-e572de. Blocks PPY-70a429. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Golden render of the starter site; browser matrix (PPY-a526ee).
Rollout: Data only.
Risk and mitigation: Low. Risk: sample stories left live look like real reporting. Mitigation: a visible sample label and a reminder in the newsroom until deleted.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
